description: Source code implementing encoding and conversion functions for GeneralizedTime and UTC time in DER format, including functions to encode time as GeneralizedTime, convert between time representations, and handle time formatting.

methods.name: WriteFourDigit
methods.description: Helper function to write a four-digit number into a byte array.

methods.name: WriteTwoDigit
methods.description: Helper function to write a two-digit number into a byte array.

methods.name: EncodeTimeAsGeneralizedTime
methods.description: Encodes a base::Time object into a GeneralizedTime structure.

methods.name: EncodePosixTimeAsGeneralizedTime
methods.description: Converts a POSIX timestamp to GeneralizedTime.

methods.name: GeneralizedTimeToPosixTime
methods.description: Converts a GeneralizedTime to POSIX timestamp.

methods.name: EncodeGeneralizedTime
methods.description: Encodes a GeneralizedTime into a DER byte array.

methods.name: EncodeUTCTime
methods.description: Encodes a GeneralizedTime into a DER byte array in UTC time format.
